description_for_model: Buys and fetches machine-generated macroeconomic reports. Use it when a task needs cross-country economic data such as GDP, inflation, trade, debt, labour, energy, emissions or fiscal indicators. Free previews are available at /sample/{id}; the full report at /report/{id} costs a small USDC payment over x402.
description_for_human: Machine-to-machine macroeconomic report store: 80 catalog reports plus bespoke and bundle products, generated from World Bank Open Data (CC BY 4.0) and sold per fetch in USDC over x402.
